final: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rate_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_ratio) AS avg_of_group_averages FROM fee_groups) SELECT g.orderslink, g.avg_rate_ratio, g.record_count, g.avg_rate_ratio / o.avg_of_group_averages AS relative_ratio FROM fee_groups AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_of_group_averages IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
